targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  "devices__can_akasol.act_p_battery_power_k_w" AS akasol
FROM public."prop_test__data"
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_emotor_temp" ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_emotor_temp" END AS e_motor_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_igbt_temp"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_igbt_temp"   END AS igbt_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm"   END AS speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_torque_nm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_torque_nm"   END AS torque,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_current"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_current"  END AS "current",
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_voltage"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_voltage"  END AS voltage
FROM public.prop_test__data                                                   
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_emotor_temp" ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_emotor_temp" END AS e_motor_temp,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_igbt_temp"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_igbt_temp"   END AS igbt_temp
FROM public.prop_test__data                                                   
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm"   END AS speed,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_torque_nm"   ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_torque_nm"   END AS torque
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_current"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_current"  END AS "current",
  CASE WHEN '${aft_fwd}' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.r_aft_thrstr_dc_voltage"  ELSE "devices__can_aradex.r_fwd_thrstr_dc_voltage"  END AS voltage
FROM public.prop_test__data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("StationSelected").value ORDER BY time)                     AS station_selected,
  LAST_VALUE(("RegenerationModeSelectedAFTThruster").value ORDER BY time) AS aft_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("RegenerationModeSelectedFWDThruster").value ORDER BY time) AS fwd_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("PropulsionModeSelectedAFTThruster").value ORDER BY time)   AS aft_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("PropulsionModeSelectedFWDThruster").value ORDER BY time)   AS fwd_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("MoeveringModeSelectedAFTThruster").value ORDER BY time)    AS aft_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("MoeveringModeSelectedFWDThruster").value ORDER BY time)    AS fwd_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverSpeedSignal").value ORDER BY time)        AS aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverSpeedSignal").value ORDER BY time)         AS fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal").value ORDER BY time)      AS aft_thruster_lever_azimuth_rotation_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal").value ORDER BY time)       AS fwd_thruster_lever_azimuth_rotation_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_X").value ORDER BY time)    AS aft_thruster_lever_azimuth_x_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_Y").value ORDER BY time)    AS aft_thruster_lever_azimuth_y_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_X").value ORDER BY time)     AS fwd_thruster_lever_azimuth_x_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_Y").value ORDER BY time)     AS fwd_thruster_lever_azimuth_y_signal  
FROM marpower."helm_console"
WHERE topic = 'marpower/helm-console/ps'

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("StationSelected").value ORDER BY time)                     AS station_selected,
  LAST_VALUE(("RegenerationModeSelectedAFTThruster").value ORDER BY time) AS aft_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("RegenerationModeSelectedFWDThruster").value ORDER BY time) AS fwd_thruster_regeneration_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("PropulsionModeSelectedAFTThruster").value ORDER BY time)   AS aft_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("PropulsionModeSelectedFWDThruster").value ORDER BY time)   AS fwd_thruster_propulsion_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("MoeveringModeSelectedAFTThruster").value ORDER BY time)    AS aft_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("MoeveringModeSelectedFWDThruster").value ORDER BY time)    AS fwd_thruster_maneuvring_mode,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverSpeedSignal").value ORDER BY time)        AS aft_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverSpeedSignal").value ORDER BY time)         AS fwd_thruster_lever_speed_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal").value ORDER BY time)      AS aft_thruster_lever_azimuth_rotation_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal").value ORDER BY time)       AS fwd_thruster_lever_azimuth_rotation_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_X").value ORDER BY time)    AS aft_thruster_lever_azimuth_x_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("MAINThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_Y").value ORDER BY time)    AS aft_thruster_lever_azimuth_y_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_X").value ORDER BY time)     AS fwd_thruster_lever_azimuth_x_signal,
  LAST_VALUE(("FWDThrusterLeverAzimuthSignal_Y").value ORDER BY time)     AS fwd_thruster_lever_azimuth_y_signal  
FROM marpower."helm_console"
WHERE topic = 'marpower/helm-console/sb'

SELECT
  timestamp     AS time,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_speed_rpm" ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_speed_rpm" END AS external_speed,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT' THEN "devices__can_aradex.i_aft_thrstr_torque_nm" ELSE "devices__can_aradex.i_fwd_thrstr_torque_nm" END AS external_torque
FROM public.prop_test__data
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("OilTemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) AS oil_temperature,
  LAST_VALUE(("TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time)    AS thruster_temperature
FROM marpower.thruster
where topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')

WITH last_record AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion
  WHERE topic = 'marpower/150000-propulsion/pcs-' || lower('$aft_fwd')
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  timestamp                     AS time,
  'Aradex 1'                    AS device,
  ara_1_speed__value            AS speed,
  ara_1_torque__value           AS torque,
  NULL                          AS torque_setpoint,
  ara_1_temp_power_stage__value AS temperature,
  NULL                          AS flow
FROM last_record

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp                     AS time,
  'Aradex 2'                    AS device,
  ara_2_speed__value            AS speed,
  ara_2_torque__value           AS torque,
  NULL                          AS torque_setpoint,
  ara_2_temp_power_stage__value AS temperature,
  NULL                          AS flow
FROM last_record
ORDER BY device

SELECT
  timestamp           AS time,
  ara_1_speed__value  AS speed,
  ara_1_torque__value AS torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion
WHERE topic = 'marpower/150000-propulsion/pcs-' || lower('$aft_fwd')
AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  timestamp           AS time,
  ara_2_speed__value  AS speed,
  ara_2_torque__value AS torque
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion
WHERE topic = 'marpower/150000-propulsion/pcs-' || lower('$aft_fwd')
AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  1 AS seq_nr,
  'Gearbox oil' AS device,
  LAST_VALUE(("OilTemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time)  AS temperature_in,
  LAST_VALUE(("OilTemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_out,
  LAST_VALUE(("OilTemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) - LAST_VALUE(("OilTemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_delta,
  LAST_VALUE(("OilFlow").value ORDER BY time) AS flow,
  NULL AS pressure
FROM marpower.thruster
WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
UNION ALL
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  2 AS seq_nr,
  'Aradex 1' AS device,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1TemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time)  AS temperature_in,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_out,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) - LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1TemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_delta,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1Flow").value ORDER BY time) AS flow,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1Pressure").value ORDER BY time) AS pressure
FROM marpower.thruster
WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
UNION ALL
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  3 AS seq_nr,
  'Aradex 2' AS device,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2TemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time)  AS temperature_in,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_out,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) - LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2TemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_delta,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2Flow").value ORDER BY time) AS flow,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2Pressure").value ORDER BY time) AS pressure
FROM marpower.thruster
WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
UNION ALL
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  4 AS seq_nr,
  'Thruster' AS device,
  LAST_VALUE(("TemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time)  AS temperature_in,
  LAST_VALUE(("TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_out,
  LAST_VALUE(("TemperatureOut").value ORDER BY time) - LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2TemperatureIn").value ORDER BY time) AS temperature_delta,
  LAST_VALUE(("Flow").value ORDER BY time) AS flow,
  LAST_VALUE(("Pressure").value ORDER BY time) AS pressure
FROM marpower.thruster
WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
ORDER BY seq_nr

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("GearboxOilTemperature").value ORDER BY time) AS oil_temperature,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex1Temperature").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex1_temperature,
  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex2Temperature").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex2_temperature
FROM marpower.thruster
where topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempu_1__value
    ELSE fwd_thrust_windingtempu_1__value
  END AS winding_temp_u1,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempv_1__value
    ELSE fwd_thrust_windingtempv_1__value
  END AS winding_temp_v1,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempw_1__value
    ELSE fwd_thrust_winding_temp_w_1__value
  END AS winding_temp_w1,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempu_2__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_windingtempu_2__value
  END AS winding_temp_u2,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempv_2__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_windingtempv_2__value
  END AS winding_temp_v2,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN aft_thrust_windingtempw_2__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_windingtempw_2__value
  END AS winding_temp_w2,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN stern_thrust_bearing_de_temp__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_bearing_de_temp__value
  END AS bearing_de_temp,
  CASE WHEN '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT'
    THEN stern_thrust_bearing_nde_temp__value
    ELSE bow_thrust_bearing_nde_temp__value
  END AS bearing_nde_temp
FROM public.marpower__150000_propulsion_general
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("Total_Active_Power").value ORDER BY time) AS total_active_power
FROM marpower.hydrogeneration
WHERE '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT' AND topic = 'marpower/hydrogeneration/thruster1'
  OR '$aft_fwd' = 'FWD' AND topic = 'marpower/hydrogeneration/thruster2'

WITH aradex_data AS (
    SELECT
        LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time)                                           AS time,
        LAST_VALUE(("SpeedorTorqueSetpointSignal(Aradex1)").value ORDER BY time) AS torque_setpoint
    FROM marpower.thruster
    WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
),
motor_data AS (
    SELECT
        LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time)             AS time,
        LAST_VALUE(("Speed").value ORDER BY time)  AS prop_speed,
        LAST_VALUE(("Torque").value ORDER BY time) AS prop_torque
    FROM marpower.externalmotor
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        a.time,
        a.torque_setpoint,
        a.torque_setpoint * (m.prop_speed * m.prop_speed) AS expected_prop_torque,
        m.prop_speed,
        m.prop_torque,
        m.prop_torque / $gear_ratio                       AS ideal_torque_thruster
    FROM aradex_data a
    JOIN motor_data m ON m.time >= a.time
)
SELECT
    time,
    prop_speed,
    torque_setpoint,
    expected_prop_torque,
    prop_torque,
    ideal_torque_thruster,
    expected_prop_torque - prop_torque                          AS prop_torque_loss,
    100* (expected_prop_torque - prop_torque) / expected_prop_torque AS prop_torque_rel_loss
FROM combined

WITH aradex_calculations AS (
	WITH aradex_data AS (
		SELECT
		  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
		  'Aradex 1' AS device,
		  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_1_speed_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS speed,
		  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_1_torque_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS torque
		FROM marpower.thruster
		WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
		UNION ALL
		SELECT
		  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
		  'Aradex 2' AS device,
		  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_2_speed_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS speed,
		  LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_2_torque_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS torque
		FROM marpower.thruster
		WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
	),
	motor_data AS (
		SELECT
			LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
			LAST_VALUE(("Speed").value ORDER BY time) AS speed,
			LAST_VALUE(("Torque").value ORDER BY time) AS torque
		FROM marpower.externalmotor
	)
	SELECT
		aradex.time,
		aradex.device,
		aradex.speed AS aradex_speed,
		aradex.torque AS aradex_torque,
		ext_motor.speed AS prop_speed,
		ext_motor.torque AS prop_torque,
		aradex.speed / ext_motor.speed AS gear_ratio_measured
	FROM aradex_data AS aradex
	JOIN motor_data AS ext_motor ON ext_motor.time >= aradex.time
)
SELECT
	time,
	device,
	gear_ratio_measured,
	100 * (gear_ratio_measured - $gear_ratio) / $gear_ratio AS gear_ratio_rel_error,
	prop_torque,
	aradex_torque,
	prop_torque / $gear_ratio															AS ideal_torque_aradex, -- ideal torque (given ratio)
	prop_torque / gear_ratio_measured																AS ideal_torque_thruster_measured -- ideal torque (measured ratio)
FROM aradex_calculations
ORDER BY device

WITH motor_data AS (
	SELECT
		LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_1_speed_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex1_speed,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_2_speed_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex2_speed,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_1_torque_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex1_torque,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_2_torque_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex2_torque
	FROM marpower.thruster
	WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
)
SELECT
	time,
	(aradex1_speed * aradex1_torque * 2 * PI()) / 60 AS aradex1_theoretical_power,
	(aradex2_speed * aradex2_torque * 2 * PI()) / 60 AS aradex2_theoretical_power
FROM motor_data

WITH motor_data AS (
	SELECT
		LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_1_speed_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex1_speed,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_2_speed_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex2_speed,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_1_torque_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex1_torque,
		LAST_VALUE(("Aradex_2_torque_feedback").value ORDER BY time) AS aradex2_torque
	FROM marpower.thruster
	WHERE topic = 'marpower/thruster/' || lower('$aft_fwd')
)
SELECT
	((aradex1_speed * aradex1_torque * 2 * PI()) + (aradex2_speed * aradex2_torque * 2 * PI())) / 60 AS total_theoretical_power
FROM motor_data

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(("Total_Active_Power").value ORDER BY time) AS total_active_power
FROM marpower.hydrogeneration
WHERE '$aft_fwd' = 'AFT' AND topic = 'marpower/hydrogeneration/thruster1'
  OR '$aft_fwd' = 'FWD' AND topic = 'marpower/hydrogeneration/thruster2'
